trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are done — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work through the roadmap below and this one takes care of itself.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end. It is the first story mission, so it unlocks naturally as you start the game.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Story progress is all it takes — there is no side requirement.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Keep playing the story missions in order and it pops at the chapter's end.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Another story-progression trophy — just follow the main missions.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. The last chapter trophy before the finale.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. It is the last story beat, so save it for the end of your story playthrough.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks through story progress — play the mission when it appears.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. A story mission, so it comes with the main path.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Follow the story and it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. A story mission — no extra steps.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. Play through the story until this mission appears, then finish it.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. A story mission on the main path.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion using the in-game checklist. This is the long grind: story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and stunts all feed the percentage, so save it for last and use the checklist to mop up what is left.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunt jumps, near misses and long airtime all count — string them together while driving around Leonida and the total climbs fast.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — there are nine activity types in total. Dip into each one (races, fishing, the shooting range, the arcade, bowling and the rest) and the trophy pops after the last new one.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Learn each challenge's target pattern, take your time on the aim, and replay the ones you miss — gold on all 42 is what counts.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 in total. Learn each course's line, cut the corners, and win one race per location.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different events count, so work through the race list instead of replaying one favourite — 20 distinct wins pops it.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Take Cal on at fishing and out-catch him — pick a good spot, watch the line, and land the bigger catch.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Pick any arcade game and play it through to the end.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Play Andy's stranger strand through to its last mission.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Follow Kenton's stranger missions to the end of his chain.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Play Billy's stranger strand to its final mission.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Meet the strangers marked around the map and finish eight of their full chains — the character finals count toward it.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Play Randy's stranger chain to its last mission.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Follow Tyrone's stranger missions to the end.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in total. This is the one trophy guides flag as possibly missable: one meditation spot belongs to Chapter 1, so meditate there before you leave Chapter 1, and clear the rest as you explore. If a story window closes, a spot may be gone for that playthrough.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Take Bret's hunting strand and track the unique animal he wants — one clean hunt does it.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — gather full sets of three to finish this one.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Open the WAiNK app and scan 100 spots around Leonida — landmarks and viewpoints are the obvious ones.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges span activities across Leonida — work through them as you play and the count reaches 50 on its own.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Bring your partner along, build a 4-star wanted level, then break line of sight and stay hidden until it clears.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row — keep the wanted level alive between robberies, since losing it breaks the chain.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new vehicle you get into counts — drive whatever you find and the discovery total climbs to 100.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus and drop five enemies before it runs out — pick a crowded fight so the targets are there.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Guides report the way to do it is to steal a passenger plane at the airport and fly away — get it airborne and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Find a Rhino tank — guides report one at the Mile Zero Air Station in Mariana County — and get inside it.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Plan it quiet: no alarms, no witnesses — slip in, take the goods, slip out.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Hit five bank vaults and get away clean each time — plan the escape before you go in.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Hit a truck on the road, grab the cash, and lose the police.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit every area of the state — the map fills in as you travel, so sweep the corners and islands you have not seen yet.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Work through the gangs one by one — one illegal operation per gang completes the set.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find a spot on Ocean Beach with a view, order a cocktail and take it in.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car straight through a showroom — windows, walls and all — the way the old games taught you.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Guides report the Kingpin Bowling alley in Port Gellhorn: take the luxury watch, the unique shotgun and the safe contents, then escape the police.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Build both protagonists up — guides report this pops when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum strength.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). Make 500 choices that affect your criminal profile — they accumulate in the background as you play, so this one comes with time.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The description points at failing once and succeeding on the second try — the exact trigger is still unconfirmed, so treat it as a retry trophy and check the guides once players pin it down.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The trigger is still unconfirmed — the description hints at witnessing something strange, so keep playing and watch for odd world events; check GTABase and Exophase for updates once players confirm it.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. The precise method is still being confirmed by guide writers.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Hand your marked bills to your contacts and keep laundering until the total reaches $250,000.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Weapons, clothes, cars — it all counts toward the $100,000 total.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy all eight purchasable garage properties across Leonida.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app on your phone and register ten vehicles you own.
trophies.name: On the Spot
